description: Use this when you have a QR code’s id (from generate_qr_code, vary_qr_code or list_qr_codes) and need its status or finished image. While the code is still being painted it waits up to `wait` seconds (25 by default) for it to finish before answering, so call it again if it is still processing. Do not use it to make a new code.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for a processing code to finish before answering, 0 to 25.

name: get_qr_code
